$comment: Kit-owned Claude Code settings. The SessionStart hooks run at the start of every session: the identity hook resolves the active user (session-start.sh on macOS/Linux, session-start.ps1 on Windows — paired, identical behavior), and the platform detector records the operating system in .claude/platform.json (so Claude runs the .ps1 kit scripts on Windows, the .sh scripts on macOS/Linux). A hook whose interpreter is absent on the current OS simply fails to launch and is ignored — SessionStart hooks are non-blocking, except the identity hook, which is meant to gate the session; the OS-appropriate flavor does the gating. See firm/practice-kit/conduct/roles.md and firm/practice-kit/conduct/running-scripts.md.
